'''Breehara''' was the main continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]].

Breehara was a sub-equatorial continent that, unlike other areas of Dressel, was covered with grasslands. The native [[Species/Legends|sentient species]] of the planet, known as [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]], evolved there.
